rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Linear MCP server provides complete Linear workspace integration with OAuth2 authentication, built using TypeScript with Hono and Zod for production deployment on both Node.js and Cloudflare Workers. The implementation offers 11 tools for managing issues, projects, teams, comments, and cycles, plus workspace metadata discovery with comprehensive filtering, pagination, and batch operations support. Features include streamable HTTP transport with session management, rate limiting with token bucket algorithms, structured logging, progress reporting, and dual-environment deployment with KV storage for token persistence, making it valuable for AI agents automating Linear workflows, project management automation, or building custom Linear integrations with enterprise-grade reliability and scalability.
